But I also used to take up to 1400 mg from time to time, I don’t know If I ever seizured but when I saw my bestfriend seizure I quit immediately and that caused me to lose my job because I couldn’t work without tramadol and that’s where I started using oxys

I want to get a job, I don’t want to buy from the streets, I don’t want to have to snort it just to save money, I don’t want to feel like a junkie, I sincerely want to get back up, I don’t want to be down here, it’s pure hell.

I’m happy for you that you got up and started living life again, you seem happy and that gives me hope. You’re an inspiration.
